GRADE 9 ENGLISH — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish between fiction and non-fiction reading materials,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction completely.
   C. Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction.

2. About Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. select and read grade appropriate fiction materials,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction completely.
   C. Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction.

3. About Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. keep a portfolio of the subject matter,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction completely.
   C. Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction.

5. About Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify nouns formed from verbs and other nouns from a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

6. About Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use nouns formed from verbs and other nouns in sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

7. About Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify nouns formed from verbs and other nouns from a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

9. About Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify and illustrate the lessons learnt from a play,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt completely.
   C. Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt.

10. About Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. relate the lessons learnt to real life experiences,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt completely.
   C. Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt.

11. About Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify and illustrate the lessons learnt from a play,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt completely.
   C. Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt.

13. About Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the double quotation marks and the bracket in a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. completely.
   C. Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5..

14. About Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use the double quotation marks and the bracket in written texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. completely.
   C. Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5..

15. About Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the double quotation marks and the bracket in a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. completely.
   C. Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mechanics of writing-Abbreviations and Acronyms 12.5.1 The Writing process 13.5..

17. About Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. spell words for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms completely.
   C. Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms.

18. About Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. write common abbreviations and acronyms in full,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms completely.
   C. Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms.

19. About Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. spell words for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms completely.
   C. Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms.

21. About Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. outline words and phrases used to express euphemism,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings.

22. About Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use euphemism to show politeness in communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings.

23. About Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. conduct a debate while adhering to conventions of polite language,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings.

25. About Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings completely.
   C. Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings.

26. About Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings completely.
   C. Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings.

27. About Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings completely.
   C. Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening to Respond: Expressing Feelings.

29. About Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify clues in the passage from which conclusions can be drawn,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies completely.
   C. Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies.

30. About Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. infer information and meaning of words and expressions from a passage,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies completely.
   C. Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies.

31. About Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise ideas in a passage,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies completely.
   C. Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies.
